latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency: 8 cycles for 0/Inf/NaN; 10 for 1 and powers of two; 16 for 3, 5, 7, 10, 1/3 and 1/5; 15 for max; 17 for maxsub. Measured with an integer-bit reset chain; 5 cycles of helper latency are subtracted. The sample experiment uses 1.0.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: frecip.s $f0, $f8; frecip.s $f1, $f9; frecip.s $f2, $f10; frecip.s $f3, $f11; frecip.s $f4, $f12; frecip.s $f5, $f13; frecip.s $f6, $f14; frecip.s $f7, $f15
throughput.init: li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4' --asm 'frecip.s $f0, $f8; frecip.s $f1, $f9; frecip.s $f2, $f10; frecip.s $f3, $f11; frecip.s $f4, $f12; frecip.s $f5, $f13; frecip.s $f6, $f14; frecip.s $f7, $f15'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent throughput: CPI 4.5 for special values; 5.5 for powers of two; 8.5 for general inputs; 8.0 for max; 9.0 for maxsub. Throughput is initiation-interval bound.

notes: Latency 8-17 cycles and throughput CPI 4.5-9 are data-dependent; the stored experiments use representative operand samples.
